description: Phase 5 real-project round c1 (2026-09-09): expected-concept and bundle regressions written before the c2 fix. Each case is a verbatim task sentence or a proposed variant; expectations come from the agents' pre-registered 00-expectation.json files and RESULTS.md proposals.

cases.query: The invoices table on the billing page is hard to scan once there are more than twenty rows.
cases.note: 2026-09-09 amended: comp-data-table legitimately carries table.virtualization; the harmful outcome is a virtualization record in the bundle 2026-09-10: inline_edit is a legitimate concept of the data-table record; forbidding the concept punished the right record

cases.query: The dispatch job form lets you lose an unsaved job by clicking another one.
cases.note: 2026-09-09 amended before the c2 rerun: the reviewer's point was that validation_errors must not be a REQUIRED concept; a bundle may still carry it via the form record

cases.query: The editor lets you close the window with unsaved changes
